browser_name.description: Browser to run UI tests in.

browser_version.description: Browser version to run UI tests in.

instance.description: Configured ServiceNow instance name. Optional; uses the current instance when omitted.

is_performance_run.description: Run the suite as a performance test instead of a functional test.

os_name.description: Operating system to run UI tests on.

os_version.description: Operating system version to run UI tests on.

run_in_cloud.description: Run the suite on the ATF Cloud Runner instead of a manual or scheduled client test runner.

test_suite_name.description: Name of the test suite; the instance resolves it. Mutually exclusive with test_suite_sys_id.

test_suite_sys_id.description: sys_id of the test suite (sys_atf_test_suite). Mutually exclusive with test_suite_name.

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum seconds to wait when wait is true (default 45, max 600). On timeout the run keeps going on the instance; the response carries progress_id for SN-Get-CICD-Progress. Many MCP clients cancel requests after about 60 seconds.

wait.description: If true (default), poll the sn_cicd progress tracker until the run finishes or timeout_seconds elapses, then return pass/fail results. If false, return the progress_id immediately.
